heading_path: Part 11—Voluntary recording of claims to interests in and rights in respect of trade marks
Division 2—Interests in, and rights in respect of, registered trade marks
116  Record not proof etc. of existence of right etc.
text: The fact that a record has been made in the Register under this Part that a person claims an interest in, or a right in respect of, a registered trade mark is not proof or evidence that the person has that right or interest.
